title: Our commitment to our supporters
intro: We value the trust and generosity of everyone who supports Toynbee Hall.

blocks.heading: How we work with supporters
paragraphs: We aim to communicate clearly, handle personal information responsibly and use support to advance our charitable work with people and communities.

blocks.heading: Questions or feedback
paragraphs: Contact Toynbee Hall if you have a question about supporting us or wish to share feedback.
